title: Holi Ayee Re
desc: The landlord's son impregnates Suhagini and promises to marry her. But he later changes his mind and refuses to accept her. When Suhagini tries to commit suicide, Anokhelal comes to her rescue.

title: Loha
desc: After a bid to arrest Sher Singh fails, officer Dayal is crippled and his partner Amar's career is sabotaged. When Amar gets another chance to nab Sher Singh, he hires two crooks for the job.

title: Bad Aur Badnaam
desc: Story begins with three villains getting a lot of money and new identities from rich man Pedro getting killed in return. Later two secret agents - James (Sanjeev Kumar) from Ringania and Ashwinikumar (Shatrughan Sinha) from Indian intelligence Bureau are shown at the top of their game. Due to some misconception, they brcome sworn enemies but meanwhile they have their jobs to do. Ashwinikumar is investigating a mysteriousplot to kill a VVIP in Delhi while James is no a Ringanian mission in india. They fight and temporarity make Peace and the rest of the movie is about their joint effort to figure out the mystery and ruin the evil plot.

title: Vidrohi
desc: Vidrohi is an action drama. The movie follows the story of an honest officer, Inspector Devendra Pratap Singh, whose only priority is to protect the law. He takes great risks to catch the dreaded dacoits Naag Singh and Bhoop Singh, however, the duo decide to surrender themselves to Police on the advice of a cunning man, who has a plan to protect them, and also make it hard for Devendra. Later, Devendra is arrested on the charges of murder of Bhoop Singh, however, he escapes the prison, when he learns about Bhoop Singh and Naag Singh’s plan. He then embarks the journey to catch the culprits and prove his innocence. Will he succeed in his mission

title: Qayamat
desc: Two close friends turn enemies when one becomes a criminal and the other, an IPS officer. Wronged by his friend, the criminal swears to take revenge once he returns from prison.
